name: agent-kitchen
description: A live pixel-art restaurant kitchen where your Claude Code and GitHub Copilot sessions are chefs cooking orders.

agentKitchen.showStatusBar.description: Show the Agent Kitchen button (chef count and who needs you) in the status bar.

agentKitchen.startOnLaunch.description: Start watching sessions when VS Code starts, so the status bar shows active chefs even before you open the kitchen.

agentKitchen.notifyOnAttention.description: Show a notification when a chef needs your attention and the kitchen tab is not visible.

agentKitchen.claudeProjectsDir.description: Override the Claude Code transcripts folder (default: ~/.claude/projects). Reopen the kitchen after changing.

agentKitchen.copilotSessionDir.description: Override the GitHub Copilot session-state folder (default: ~/.copilot/session-state). Reopen the kitchen after changing.

agentKitchen.includeVSCodeChat.description: Show GitHub Copilot Chat sessions from this VS Code (Chat view and agent mode) as chefs. Reopen the kitchen after changing.
